context:
Goal: a lane whose only change since its review is a main merge plus a small fix merges on a fix check, not a full new review.
Problem (rule): the rule says a wider diff starts again at round 1. After a main merge, the old-to-new diff holds all of main's changes, so every main merge counts as "wider" and forces a full round.
Based on (ruling): rule roles-review-cap-three: a small fix gets a fix check; a FAIL or a wider diff starts at round 1. Asked because "wider" is unclear after a main merge.
Based on (ruling): decisions/hold-unsafe-after-round-3: a fix check covers only a fix to a round's defect. Asked again because tonight at least six PRs took a full round for a main merge plus a one-line form fix, a cost that ruling did not weigh.
Based on (observed): #1679, #1670, #1439, #1472, #1449 and #1655 each took a full round for a main merge plus a one-line form fix (coordinator, 23:40 CST Nov 7).
Departs from: main, where a fix's size is judged on old..new — it is judged on the PR's own diff (main...head) plus conflict edits.
Meanwhile: the width follow-up on step fix-check-guard-scope waits on this answer. The guard-question part (#1787) goes on.

options.gain: A main merge alone never forces a full review, so reviews go to real changes.
options.how: The fix check's "adds nothing else" test reads main...head and the conflict edits, as the guard question now does.
options.label: Judge size on the PR's own diff plus conflict edits (recommended)
options.lose: A bad conflict resolution hidden in a merge is caught only if the fix check reads the conflict edits.

options.gain: Every byte since the last review is judged.
options.how: The fix check's size test keeps reading every byte since the last review.
options.label: Keep old..new
options.lose: A full review round after every main merge.

reply: You picked a (06:08 CST Nov 8): after a main merge, a fix's size is judged on main...head plus conflict edits. Routed to the coordinator and lane session_013NEJKzEteiJ3oyJR8P7PPn; home: step fix-check-guard-scope (PR #1787). Closed 06:12 CST Nov 8.
short: Fix-check width after a main merge
title: After a main merge, is a fix's size judged on the PR's own diff?
why: The coordinator recommends a: it keeps reviews on real changes, and the fix check still reads the conflict edits.
